data.name: chasing the wildrness
data.detailed_description:
The road ahead has no navigation and no single destination.

Chasing the Wilderness is an open-world adventure centered on exploration, off-road driving, and helping people you meet along the way. Take control of your vehicle and venture into a remote land that is beautiful, unpredictable, and dangerous.

Road signs, distant mountains, lights in the valley, and tracks left behind are your guides. There is no route that is always correct. A promising shortcut may end in deep mud, while a longer mountain road may lead to supplies, stranded travelers, and places you have never seen before.

NO NAVIGATION, ONLY DIRECTION

The map will not plan every turn for you.

Study road signs, mountains, rivers, and changing weather before choosing your next path. Follow the safety of an old road, descend a steep slope, or cross shallow water in search of a faster but riskier route.

Getting lost is not always failure. It may be the beginning of a new discovery.

MAN AND MACHINE AGAINST THE WILDERNESS

Fuel determines how far you can travel. Vehicle damage affects your ability to continue, while nitrous may offer one last chance to escape steep slopes and deep mud.

Preparation, vehicle maintenance, and the decision to keep going can change the outcome of every journey.

  • Plan routes and manage fuel

  • Monitor and repair vehicle damage

  • Escape mud, rivers, and steep terrain

  • Adapt your driving to weather and road conditions

ENCOUNTERS ALONG THE ROAD

You are not the only traveler in this wilderness.

You may find a vehicle stranded on a mountain road, a traveler lost in a valley, or a remote camp urgently waiting for fuel and spare parts.

Tow damaged vehicles, search for missing people, and deliver essential supplies. These encounters are more than missions. They are how you form a connection with the world around you.

A CHANGING WORLD

From golden grasslands to violet storms, from silent night roads to rivers swollen by heavy rain, the environment is never just a static backdrop.

Visibility, lighting, weather, and road conditions continue to change. Even a familiar route may feel completely different the next time you travel through it.

CROSS REAL OBSTACLES

  • Navigate muddy mountain roads and rushing rivers

  • Cross broken bridges and unstable terrain

  • Use ferries to reach the other side of major waterways

  • Face changing daylight and sudden severe weather

  • Discover hidden routes and remote mountain summits

  • Rescue travelers, tow vehicles, and deliver supplies

  • Collect fuel, parts, and discoveries from the journey

THE JOURNEY MATTERS MORE THAN THE DESTINATION

Through every crossing, rescue, and unexpected encounter, you may discover that this journey is not simply about reaching the summit.

It is about finding your own answer somewhere between solitude and wonder.

data.short_description: Drive into a vast wilderness with no fixed navigation. Read road signs and terrain, manage fuel and vehicle condition, cross mud, rivers, broken bridges, and storms, rescue stranded travelers, and find your own way forward.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 / AMD Vega-56
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700/ Ryzen 9 3900XT
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / Ryzen 9 3900XT or equivalent
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
